openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Location lead as found (unverified): Rivne (reported temporary base since March 2022; relocated from Luhansk to Rubizhne in 2014, then to Rivne in 2022 - armyinform 2022-04-03, Suspilne 2022, osvita.ua 2026, Ombudsman 2024-03-25 and report dated 2026-04-09; vstup.osvita.ua lists "населений пункт: м. Рівне")

Relocation lead (unverified): Leads: evacuated from Luhansk to Rubizhne (Luhansk region) in 2014; evacuated again to Rivne from March 2022 ("Since March 2022, the LSMU has temporarily moved to the city of Rivne" - Wikipedia; armyinform 2022-04-03 "У Рівному запрацював евакуйований з Луганська медуніверситет"; Suspilne 2022: "понад дві сотні студентів набрав Луганський медуніверситет, який через бойові дії переїхав у Рівне"). Rector named in UNIAN interview: Serhii Smirnov ("у мирні часи ми повернемось до Луганська"; "після переміщення в місто Рубіжне у нас було понад півтори тисячі студентів"). Staff housed in dormitories provided by the Rivne regional military administration; teaching uses Rivne educational and medical facilities. Ombudsman monitored the "Крим-Україна, Донбас-Україна" educational centre operating "на базі релокованого в Рівненську область Луганського державного медичного університету" (2024-03-25) and published an LDMU report dated 2026-04-09 (content not read). osvita.ua "70 років ЛДМУ: як працює релокований медуніверситет у Рівному" (2026). Polish FRSE page: 867 students, 268 employees (undated). Still operating under Ukrainian MoH per vstup.osvita.ua ("Підпорядкування: Міністерство охорони здоров'я України"). Older vstup.osvita.ua records still show Rubizhne, reflecting the two moves.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: a Russian-run institution in occupied Luhansk ('St. Luke Luhansk State Medical University', inventory slug luhansk-st-luke-occupied) uses the same core name; Meduza (2025-11-05) reports it 'admitted a group of Indian students to its general medicine program' in October 2025 - 'its first foreign enrollment in more than a decade'. Any 'Lugansk State Medical University' agent-site marketing (matchtocollege, rmcedu, selectyouruniversity, medlinkstudents, edarabia) that places the campus in Luhansk/Lugansk may describe the occupied institution or pre-2014 conditions.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Twice-relocated institution (2014 Rubizhne, 2022 Rivne); teaching reportedly uses borrowed Rivne facilities - clinical-base, hostel and licence-volume details for foreigners are unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No official page could be opened; English-medium teaching and foreign-applicant admission rest only on agent sites and a dated Wikipedia-derived line ('English or Russian').

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO, Study in Ukraine or NAQA listing was read directly; the NAQA 2026-02-17 annex hit is unread and could concern any decision (accreditation, refusal, or conditional).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Older aggregator pages still give Rubizhne (Luhansk region) as location; a directory card must show Rivne with the relocation caveat and must not show Luhansk as an operating campus.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Aggregator 'IVth accreditation level' claim is obsolete terminology and unverified.
